name: Cafecito Beans
description: Cafecito Beans lets agents search news, reports, research, and official statements, track trends, and compare coverage across publishers. It provides read-only access through a hosted MCP server. Each user connects with a Cafecito API key.

prompts.text: What news about GPU supply shortages is trending this week?
Find lawsuits and official statements about Nvidia since the start of this month.
Compare publishers’ coverage of semiconductor export restrictions this week.

apps.name: Cafecito Beans
apps.description: Read-only article search, stories, trends, source details, related coverage, and mentions, through the hosted Beans MCP server with a Cafecito API key.

fields.label: Cafecito API key
fields.hint: Enter only the key from Cafecito API Keys. Do not include Bearer.
